conjectures.statement: Yoga–Buddhi with known ξ equals the MMSE estimator only when the antithesis is physically available; the observable-only Gaussian MMSE from (y_A, y_B) is the correct physical replacement.
conjectures.pass_criterion: Oracle paired projection MSE is ~0 when ξ is supplied; observable-only MMSE matches analytic Wiener MSE within 5σ sampling error and never receives s or n at inference.
conjectures.notes: Oracle identity verified; MMSE is observable-only Wiener filter.

conjectures.statement: Under the protocol Gaussian model, squeezed-reference MSE ordering matches the closed form across independent seeds.
conjectures.pass_criterion: For default (Vs=Vn=k=1, η=0.8, r=0.7), sample ordering agrees with analytic ordering on ≥3 seeds; |analytic-sample| ≤ 5σ SE.
conjectures.notes: Analytic MSE ordering checked against mse_optimal closed forms.

conjectures.statement: An axiomatic stability coefficient Ξ_SNR (or purity/Fisher proxy) remains in (0, 1] on all foundation sweep points; legacy Equation-11 Ξ need not.
conjectures.pass_criterion: Over the Week-2 spike grid, min(Ξ_SNR) > 0 and max(Ξ_SNR) ≤ 1; legacy Ξ is reported without clipping.

conjectures.statement: Circuit-B Branch W (worked-example thresholding) yields a macro marker that does not collapse during the noise spike the way legacy Ξ does; damping corresponds to a CPTP attenuator on covariances.
conjectures.pass_criterion: Branch W keeps Ξ_SNR in (0,1] through spikes; attenuator_channel preserves physical covariances; if neither branch satisfies a stated contraction inequality, status becomes refuted/open with counterexamples.

limitations: Classical Monte Carlo of an ideal Gaussian optical model.
MMSE coefficients use known model parameters (parameter oracle), not unknown calibration.
Moving-average/median baselines see only y_A; MMSE also uses y_B — equal-mode resource note applies.
Oracle paired projection is not deployable.
